description: Every Slack read your token can make, mirrored to local SQLite so your history outlives Slack's own retention wall.

novel_features.name: Archive Recall
novel_features.description: Find messages in your local archive, including ones Slack has already hidden behind the 90-day retention wall.

novel_features.name: Archive Coverage
novel_features.description: Show what date range your local mirror actually holds per channel, and where the gaps are.

novel_features.name: Catch-up
novel_features.description: See what happened while you were away: new volume per channel, messages that mention you, and threads still waiting on your reply.

novel_features.name: Stale Thread Radar
novel_features.description: List threads across the archive where the last reply is not yours and nobody has answered since.

novel_features.name: Channel Health
novel_features.description: Compare your channels by messages per day, distinct posters, median first-reply latency, and days idle.

novel_features.name: User Activity
novel_features.description: Profile where one person posts, which threads they carry, and when they were last seen.

novel_features.name: Identity Card
novel_features.description: Turn an opaque Slack ID, handle, or email into one card with shared channels, timezone, DND state, and last-seen.
